frame: mirrored image (cv2.flip(frame, 1)); camera frame = OpenCV with x flipped
model: M8 Phase 7 re-implementation + tgaze eye-patch PCA16 (EyePCA), head_pose angles = rich16d
training_split: Phase 8 v4: train 1234 ids (v3_app 234 ids x200 + v4_1k 1000 ids x100), 146,800 samples; validation [500-518] (519 failed); test [520-599] minus 559; single seed 0
eye_pca_note: eye_norm_r16 input = 168 landmark dims + PCA16 of tgaze appearance.eye_patch (48x32 CLAHE, both eyes, mirrored frame)

training_data.generator: scripts/generate_gaze_dataset_v3.py (v2 geometry / sampling + per-identity skin, iris, eyebrows, eyelashes, eyelid gains & offset, lighting, camera degradation, hair; no glasses, no clothes)
training_data.per_identity_weighting: none: loss = mean over samples, batches = shuffled whole groups (p7train.py); a v3_app identity (200 samples) weighs 2x a v4_1k identity (100 samples); per_id_max not used
training_data.note: v3_app train 234 ids x200 + v4_1k 1000 ids x100; val/test as split_v3_*
training_data.skin_pool: train / validation / test A use the training skins; test B (560-599) uses 4 held-out skins only
training_data.warning: no v2 / Phase 7 ids in train: Phase 5 test ids [7, 11] are unseen, but every identity has a different appearance from v2

seed_selection.criterion: only seed 0 was trained for this condition (no selection); early stopping on validation ids

sets.clean: gaze_dataset_p7_ids 120-139 (uniform appearance, the Phase 7 test set)

synthetic_test_metrics.calib_cm_note: p7calib protocol: 0/1/5/9 points, 2 'random' samples per point, primary correction (affine ridge lambda 25); evaluated on samples not used for calibration, so '0' differs slightly from cm_mean
